summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.90. Baseline for o.polat@aegean.edu is twice-daily MFA-approved logins from Turkey (Manisa) on known devices DEV-H05-L / DEV-H05-P via the university ASN. The alert shows a sharp deviation: repeated successful IMAP authentications with no MFA prompt and no device_id from unrelated cloud infrastructure — DigitalOcean (NL/Amsterdam) on 2026-10-10 and Hetzner Online (DE/Falkenstein) on 2026-10-11 — indicating use of valid credentials outside the normal MFA-protected session. A prior IMAP failure from the DigitalOcean IP is consistent with credential access attempts. Corroborating malicious activity: a mail rule event at 2026-10-11 01:20:30 deleting items into Deleted Items via API, consistent with an actor covering tracks after mailbox access. Multiple successful logins from two different cloud providers in two countries, absent MFA/device context, plus destructive mail-rule manipulation, confirms account takeover rather than a benign anomaly or weak signal.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
